title: Sayres Lake Recreation Site

services.name: South Sayres Group Site
services.desc: This waterfront group site is equipped with a dock and is ideal for small family or friend gatherings. It is well suited for activities such as paddle boarding, kayaking, and fishing. Prior to bringing a trailer it is recommended to visit the site in advance to assess both the group area and road conditions for vehicle suitability. The site can accommodate up to four medium-sized trailers. South Sayres is booked by reservations only. Prior to your arrival, you will receive further instructions by email regarding key pickup at Rock Creek recreation site (7km mark) and other essential information. Check in is 2pm - Check out is 12pm. You must check out and return the key to the Host at Rock
